AUDIENCE: new and returning Korean language learners
LESSON_FOCUS: core word and phrase typing fluency
PILOT_GOAL: This pilot adds consistent, repeatable writing practice that fits class, lab, and independent work.
KEYBOARD_NOTES: Use the South Korean (KRV7) layout selected for this course, and confirm browser focus before typing attempts.
LEARNING_PATH_NOTES: Build stable accuracy first, then increase speed in short repeat sessions.
TEACHER_NOTES: Track retries and highlight measurable growth in accuracy and completion consistency.
CLOSING_MESSAGE: The practical outcome is measurable writing practice in a familiar Moodle workflow.
